quotations.old_english: Hit geondbrǽded wearþ beddum and bolstrum
quotations.english: it was overspread with beds and bolsters

source_text: geond-brǽdan; p. -brǽdde; pp. -brǽded [geond over, brǽdan to spread] To overspread; superstern&e-short;re :-- Hit geondbrǽded wearþ beddum and bolstrum it was overspread with beds and bolsters, Beo. Th. 2483; B. 1239.
